scope: Read-only design review of scoped unknown-world identity and implementation; bounded local integration only.
decision: Unknown world values carry fresh persistent tokens, distinct from anatomical declarations. Same token may be reused/restored; geometry equality never infers identity.

review_findings.finding: Removing pre-evidence persistence exposes metre/micrometre numeric affine relabelling into millimetres.
review_findings.resolution: SampleSpaces.inWorld rejects non-RAS/non-mm frames; NiftiHeader.spaceIn checks header unit plus fallbackSpatialUnit; direct and header/full read regressions added.

review_findings.finding: Downsample constructs fresh geometry and loses original frame.
review_findings.resolution: derivedD3 retains exact source frame, persistent geometry when supported, and non-spatial axes; both volume and series paths covered.

review_findings.finding: Private surface display box frame is not a scientific world.
review_findings.resolution: Use one private ephemeral display frame; public cursor linkage still requires WorldLink.

additional_parent_finding.finding: Generic label nearest-neighbour volume/series resampling used raw coordinates without world alignment.
additional_parent_finding.resolution: Both entry points require checked world alignment; foreign unknown worlds refuse; same-world label values remain unchanged.

compatibility_limits: Legacy scalafim-ras-d3 decode requires explicit migration; generic image4s frame-record restore is not blocked globally.
Geometry-only estimate/LNA/Zarr metadata reconstruction mints fresh unknown worlds per open; it does not preserve cross-open identity without an explicit stored world record.
2D synthetic constructor identity is outside this D3 neuroimaging world migration.
final_verdict: No blocking source-review findings; final affected consumer platform checks still required.
independent_test_reproduction: Reviewer did not rerun tests; parent owns actual check receipts.
